newsitem.title: Malaysia: KL palm oil ends week down after choppy trade.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends week down after choppy trade.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
May (3rd pos) 1,264 rgt/tonne Mar (south) 1,315
Open/Hi/Low 1,278/1,279/1,261 Prev close 1,322.50
Prev settlement 1,276 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES -Prices fell after a steady opening, as commission houses and trade selling dragged prices down at the close. SGS (M) Sdn Bhd and Caleb Brett Feb palm oil exports were within market expectations. Market expected to trend lower on poor demand and speculation about output in coming months.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Dealing was selective and the market followed the futures sector.

Malaysian palm oil prices ended lower after selling by commission houses and trade liquidation hit sentiment. However, price were not affected by the release of the export data for February, traders said. "The afternoon session drifted in a tight range as there were no fresh developments," a trader said, adding that the release of palm oil exports data by cargo surveyors SGS (M) Sdn Bhd and Caleb Brett had no impact as the figures were within trade expectations.
"The market was choppy in earlier trade as there was a lot of speculation on the February export data," a trader said.
Some traders had earlier estimated the February data at around 460,000 tonnes.
On Friday, SGS (M) Sdn Bhd said palm oil exports for February was 453,287 tonnes and Caleb Brett at 455,317 tonnes.
"There was a major commission house selling in the market this morning from 1,270 to 1,261 ringgit for May futures," a trader said.
May futures fell 12 ringgit to 1,264 ringgit ($509.27) a tonne. The next support for May futures contract is seen at 1,250 ringgit with resistance at 1,280.
Prospects of poor export business and larger output in the coming months could pull down prices in the short-term, traders said.
Physical Mar (south) crude palm oil was offered 1,315 ringgit against bids of 1,310 with earlier trades done at 1,310.
Mar central) saw offers at 1,310 and bids at 1,315 and Mar (north) at 1,295 against bids 1,290.
Apr (south) was offered at 1,310 with bids at 1,300 and Apr (central) at 1,310 with bids at 1,307.50
Among refined products, Mar RBD palm oil was offered at $560 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Apr at $552.50.
Mar RBD palm olein saw offers at $590, Apr at $582.50 and Apr/May/Jun at $575. Apr was dealt at $582.50 and $579.
Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $465 and Mar/Apr palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $307.50.
